title: Preparing the SA Form 1 vendor's statement
description: What to gather so your conveyancer can prepare the SA Form 1 vendor's statement, and when it must be given. Summarised from SA.GOV.AU and Law Handbook guidance.

sources.title: What is on the vendor's statement
Law Handbook: selling a home, vendor's statement
sources.organisation: Legal Services Commission of South Australia

items.title: Engage a conveyancer or lawyer to prepare the SA Form 1 vendor's statement and contract
Give them your certificate of title details and any caveats, easements or covenants you know of
Tell them about any mortgage and your lender's details
Find your latest council rates, water rates and other outgoings notices
Gather approvals and completion documents for building work on the property
Get building indemnity insurance certificates for domestic building work done in the last 5 years
items.detail: Ask your builder or check the insurer's register.

items.title: Give them the strata or community corporation's contact details
Have your power of attorney, probate or other authority to sell ready
Read the statement carefully and sign it as vendor
Make sure it is served on the buyer before they sign the contract
items.detail: If served after signing, it must be at least 10 clear days before settlement.

items.title: For an auction, make it available at the agent's office 3 business days before and at the venue 30 minutes before
Keep proof of how and when it was served
